Connect your ELEGOO kit

Use desktop Chrome or Edge. Upload the sketch, close Arduino Serial Monitor, then choose its USB port. The game pauses while this panel is open.

Keyboard rehearsal is available with or without a kit.

Test each new component

Upload the V4 sketch below first. Tests keep the farm paused and stop automatically. In play, crows enable clap detection and hurricane warnings start the fan.

Connection detailsNo controller connected.
Sketch downloads and USB messages

Team V4 sends temperature, day/night, water, clap events, and fan/microphone status at 9600 baud.

{"type":"temperature","value":24}
{"type":"dayNight","value":"night"}
{"type":"water","value":300}

The game sends LCD status, crow listening, fan, movement, and sound commands automatically. STOP_ALL stops outputs on pause or disconnect. A four-second connection timeout also stops the hardware.
